title: Alexandria investigation topic
description: research/<slug>/topic.yaml -- the metadata file for one investigation. This formalizes only the fields that are (a) read by src/alexandria/infrastructure/research_repo.py's lenient parser (that module now lives in dhk/minority-report, but reads this file from here), (b) consumed by a downstream tool -- DHK-website's publish skill reads `origin` and `claim_under_test` as excerpt source material, or (c) documented as normative by docs/ux/RFC-0007-idea-to-expression-flow.md §08, whose stage-01 lanes are exactly `origin`, `claim_under_test`, `why_now`, `scope`. Deliberately incomplete: existing investigations also carry topic_kind, decision, scope_limitation, subject_product, comparison_set, and at least four different names for 'which run this came from' (commission_run, commissioned_run, current_run, probe_run) -- none of that is formalized here because none of it has stabilized into one shape yet. Per-run metadata has its own, separate contract once a run reaches that convention: schemas/run-record.schema.json. additionalProperties is deliberately true: an investigation is not invalid for carrying fields beyond this schema.

status.description: Free-form lifecycle status, operator- or `publish`-assigned. Deliberately not an enum: observed values include 'single-source-draft', 'single-source-probe', 'brief-draft', 'bronze-complete-prior-art-gap', 'research-completed', and 'graded-multi-model', and new shapes of investigation are expected to introduce new values. research_repo.py reads this as an opaque string; nothing currently validates it against a fixed set.

assurance_level.description: One of Alexandria's three cumulative research assurance levels (README.md). The parser reads this case-insensitively and lowercases it; store it lowercase.

slug.description: Matches the investigation's own directory name, research/<slug>/.

origin.description: Editorial, human-written: why this question was asked. Never machine-generated -- a tool drafting the rest of this file from a completed run deliberately leaves this field to the operator, because a tool cannot know why a question was asked. Normative per RFC-0007 §08 (the flow view's stage-01 lanes) and read by DHK-website's publish skill as excerpt source material. Present on commissioned, graded investigations; its absence on an informal single-source probe is expected, not an error -- see e.g. research/2026-08-21-sf-downtown-place-names, which has `scope` but not this field.

claim_under_test.description: Editorial, human-written: the proposition the investigation actually tests, stated so it can be rejected rather than confirmed. Same provenance and optionality as `origin`.

why_now.description: Editorial, human-written: what decision or deadline makes this worth running now. Same provenance and optionality as `origin`.

scope.description: Editorial, human-written: what was deliberately excluded and why. Appears more broadly than `origin`/`claim_under_test`/`why_now` -- observed on single-source probes as well as commissioned, graded investigations.
